description: This source file defines an interface 'IDurableSet<T>' and its implementation class 'DurableSet<T>'. The code focuses on a durable, persistent set data structure with serialization, versioning, and state machine features, used within the Orleans framework for reliable, stateful actor (grain) storage.

classes.name: DurableSet<T>
classes.description: A durable, persistent set data structure implementing IDurableSet<T> and managing state with serialization, command application, and snapshot capabilities within Orleans.

methods.name: DurableSet
methods.description: Constructor initializing the durable set, registering it with a state machine manager.

methods.name: Count
methods.description: Returns the number of items in the set.

methods.name: IsReadOnly
methods.description: Indicates whether the set is read-only; always false.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the state machine, clearing the set.

methods.name: Apply
methods.description: Applies a log entry to update the set's state based on serialized commands.

methods.name: AppendEntries
methods.description: Encapsulated as part of the state machine, intentionally left blank.

methods.name: AppendSnapshot
methods.description: Serializes the current state of the set as a snapshot.

methods.name: WriteSnapshotToBufferWriter
methods.description: Static method to serialize the set's current items into a buffer.

methods.name: Clear
methods.description: Clears the set and logs the clear command.

methods.name: Contains
methods.description: Checks if an item exists in the set.

methods.name: CopyTo
methods.description: Copies items to an array starting at a given index.

methods.name: GetEnumerator
methods.description: Returns an enumerator over the set.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Adds an item to the set and logs the add command.

methods.name: Remove
methods.description: Removes an item from the set and logs the remove command.

methods.name: ApplyAdd
methods.description: Internal method to add an item to the set without logging.

methods.name: ApplyRemove
methods.description: Internal method to remove an item from the set without logging.

methods.name: ApplyClear
methods.description: Internal method to clear the set without logging.

methods.name: DeepCopy
methods.description: Method for creating a deep copy; not implemented.

methods.name: ExceptWith
methods.description: Removes multiple items from the set.

methods.name: IsProperSubsetOf
methods.description: Checks subset relation.

methods.name: IsProperSupersetOf
methods.description: Checks superset relation.

methods.name: IsSubsetOf
methods.description: Checks subset relation.

methods.name: IsSupersetOf
methods.description: Checks superset relation.

methods.name: Overlaps
methods.description: Checks if overlaps with another collection.

methods.name: SetEquals
methods.description: Checks if sets are equal.

methods.name: IntersectsWith
methods.description: Intersects with another collection, updates storage if changed.

methods.name: SymmetricExceptWith
methods.description: Symmetric difference with another collection, updates storage if changed.

methods.name: UnionWith
methods.description: Adds all items from another collection.
